settings.title: Set the geometry
settings.description: Lock gravel geometry on the jig — wider clearance and a slacker head angle than road.

settings.title: Join & wrap
settings.description: Bond the tubes with epoxy and wrap each joint with carbon-fibre tow.

settings.title: Cure
settings.description: Leave it for a full cure — that's where maximum joint strength comes from.

settings.title: Sand, seal & ride

settings.quote: I've got five bikes and this is my favourite — it feels stiffer, dampens vibration better, and I feel safer and more confident on it.

settings.question: Do I need power tools?
settings.answer: No. Just basic hand tools — a hacksaw, files, sandpaper, a measuring tape and a work surface (a table around 1200 × 600 mm). Everything else is in the kit.

settings.question: What if I make a mistake?
settings.answer: Most mistakes are fixable. Epoxy can be sanded back and re-applied, and bamboo is forgiving. If you're stuck, our community has seen every problem — someone will have the answer within hours.

settings.question: How strong is it really?
settings.answer: Around 28,000 PSI tensile strength — comparable to mild steel, but lighter. We've seen under a 1% failure rate across 4,000+ builds since 2012, and the design has been tested with Swansea University. Builders tour continents and ride daily.

settings.question: Is it weatherproof?
settings.answer: Yes. Finished frames are sealed with epoxy resin. Dry your bike after wet rides and store it indoors, and it'll last 8–12 years with proper care.

settings.question: Not sure which size?
settings.answer: Send us your height and inside-leg measurement and we'll recommend the perfect fit — or choose a Custom frame, made to your measurements.

settings.question: Can I use Cycle to Work?
settings.answer: Yes — build your bamboo bike through the government's Cycle to Work scheme and save hundreds through salary sacrifice.
